scenes.bodyText:
=== VALIDATION MASTER TESTING CONSOLE ===

Select a system or feature domain to inspect and verify:

choices.label: Provision Complete 35-Piece Wardrobe
choices.tooltip: Instantly place all 35 test equipment items into your backpack.

choices.label: Launch Interactive Sex Simulation
choices.tooltip: Test interactive CYOA sex mechanics (solo, consensual partner, or dom/sub).

choices.label: Access Biomantic Transformation Lab
choices.tooltip: Test transformation chamber UI, body mutations, fluids, and gestation.

choices.label: Approach Arcane Infusion Altar
choices.tooltip: Test enchanting UI, essences, focus paths, and infusion crafting.

choices.label: Spar with Combat Dummy
choices.tooltip: Engage in turn-based combat to test maneuvers, spells, and weapon skills.

choices.label: 1. Inventory & Equipment Checks
choices.tooltip: Verify HAS_ITEM and EQUIPPED_SLOT condition evaluations.

choices.label: 2. Quest & Variable Checks
choices.tooltip: Verify QUEST_STAGE, VAR_MIN, VAR_MAX, and VAR_EQUALS conditions.

choices.label: 3. Time & Calendar Checks
choices.tooltip: Verify TIME_PHASE and TIME_HOUR_BETWEEN conditions.

choices.label: 4. Stat Threshold Checks
choices.tooltip: Verify STAT_MIN, STAT_MAX, STAT_CHECK, and DOMINANCE_BETWEEN conditions.

choices.label: 5. Biology & Anatomy Checks
choices.tooltip: Verify HAS_TAG, HAS_MUTATION, IS_PREGNANT, GENDER_IS, RACE_IS, and TARGET_HAS_TAG.

choices.label: 6. Perks & Trait Flag Checks
choices.tooltip: Verify HAS_PERK and HAS_PERK_FLAG conditions.

choices.label: 7. Boolean Compound Logic (AND, OR, NOT, LEAF)
choices.tooltip: Verify compound boolean node tree evaluation.

choices.label: 8. General Status Effects System Lab
choices.tooltip: Inspect, apply, and test permanent, timed, biological, and future status effects on self and targets.

choices.label: Close Terminal
choices.tooltip: Exit the testing terminal.

scenes.bodyText: All 35 validation equipment items (test_eq_*) have been successfully transferred to your inventory backpack. You may now equip, unequip, and displace all 35 slots of your character paperdoll.

=== INTERACTIVE CYOA SEX SIMULATION ===

Select a scenario to launch the interactive intimate state (sexState):

choices.label: Consensual Intimate Scene (with Valida)
choices.tooltip: Enter sexState with Valida as an active, consenting partner.

choices.label: Solo Intimacy & Body Exploration
choices.tooltip: Enter solo sexState for self-exploration and arousal mechanics.

scenes.bodyText: A clockwork combat dummy raises its padded training armaments, ready to engage in tactical turn-based combat. Choose an approach:

choices.label: Fight (Engage in Combat)
choices.tooltip: Enter turn-based combat to test maneuvers, weapon skills, and spells.

choices.label: Bribe (Offer 25¤)
choices.tooltip: Test bribe resolution.

choices.label: Evade / Flee
choices.tooltip: Test flight resolution.

choices.label: Surrender
choices.tooltip: Test submission and defeat resolution.

scenes.bodyText:
=== BIOMANTIC TRANSFORMATION MATRIX ===

Configure anatomical transformations, fluid saturation, and gestation parameters:

choices.label: Open Interactive Transformation Chamber UI
choices.tooltip: Transition to transformationState to test character customization sliders and views.

choices.label: Expand Breasts (+10 cm)
choices.tooltip: Apply growth transformation to chest tissue.

choices.label: Reduce Breasts (-5 cm)
choices.tooltip: Apply reduction transformation to chest tissue.

choices.label: Grow Virile Member (+5 cm)
choices.tooltip: Apply length expansion transformation to penis.

choices.label: Infuse Lactation (+250 ml Milk)
choices.tooltip: Fill breast glands with nourishing fluid.

choices.label: Stretch Orifice (+1.0 cm)
choices.tooltip: Increase vaginal elasticity and resting diameter.

choices.label: Impregnate (Induce Gestation)
choices.tooltip: Initiate pregnancy with litter size 2.

choices.label: Induce Immediate Childbirth
choices.tooltip: Trigger birth resolution if pregnant.

choices.label: Mutate Body Covering (Soft Fur)
choices.tooltip: Change skin covering to Fur.

scenes.bodyText: The biomantic realignment cycle has successfully completed. Biological adjustments have been committed to player anatomy.

=== ARCANE INFUSION & ENCHANTING ALTAR ===

Channels of distilled mana pulse through the altar's runic lattice. Select an option:

choices.label: Launch Interactive Enchanting Altar UI
choices.tooltip: Transition to enchantingState to select base items, set focus, and craft infusions.

choices.label: Grant Arcane Essence (+100 Essence)
choices.tooltip: Acquire essence required for crafting enchantments.

choices.label: Grant Infusion Reagents
choices.tooltip: Receive infused reagents for altar crafting trials.

scenes.bodyText: Raw magical essence and infusion matrices have been channeled into your possession.
A warm, mellow glow emanates from the fireplace embers. Resting here restores physical and mental vigor.

choices.label: Rest and Restore Vitality (+200 HP, +100 MP, +100 Stamina, -50 Lust)
choices.tooltip: Full health and stamina restoration.

scenes.bodyText: You take a long, peaceful rest beside the warm hearth. Your body feels rejuvenated and ready for trials.
The quiet alcove holds scholarly tomes, maps, and field provisions:

choices.label: Collect Field Stipend (+500 Gold & Potions)
choices.tooltip: Receive currency and consumable health/mana potions.

scenes.bodyText: You collect the designated field stipend and storable rations.

[Domain: Inventory & Equipment]
Select an inventory condition verification probe:

choices.label: Probe: HAS_ITEM (Check test_eq_headwear count >= 1)
choices.tooltip: Verifies player has test_eq_headwear in backpack.

choices.label: Probe: EQUIPPED_SLOT (Check any item equipped in TORSO_UNDER)
choices.tooltip: Verifies TORSO_UNDER slot is occupied.

choices.label: Probe: EQUIPPED_SLOT (Check specific 'item_linen_shirt' in TORSO_UNDER)
choices.tooltip: Verifies item_linen_shirt specifically is equipped in TORSO_UNDER.

scenes.bodyText:
[Domain: Quests & Variables]
Select a quest stage verification probe:

choices.label: Probe: QUEST_STAGE (Check root_delivery == 0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies exact quest stage matching.

choices.label: Probe: VAR_MIN (Check root_delivery >= 0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies minimum stage threshold.

choices.label: Probe: VAR_MAX (Check root_delivery <= 10)
choices.tooltip: Verifies maximum stage threshold.

choices.label: Probe: VAR_EQUALS / CHECK_VAR (Check root_delivery == 0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies variable equivalence check alias.

scenes.bodyText:
[Domain: Time & Calendar]
Select a temporal condition verification probe:

choices.label: Probe: TIME_PHASE (Check current phase is NIGHT)
choices.tooltip: Verifies time phase matches NIGHT.

choices.label: Probe: TIME_PHASE (Check current phase is DAY)
choices.tooltip: Verifies time phase matches DAY.

choices.label: Probe: TIME_HOUR_BETWEEN (Check current hour is 0-24)
choices.tooltip: Verifies calendar hour falls within the valid span.

scenes.bodyText:
[Domain: Stats & Attributes]
Select a stat threshold verification probe:

choices.label: Probe: STAT_MIN (Check physique >= 1.0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies player physique meets minimum threshold.

choices.label: Probe: STAT_MAX (Check corruption <= 100.0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies corruption stat does not exceed cap.

choices.label: Probe: STAT_CHECK (Check physique in range [1, 999])
choices.tooltip: Verifies bounded stat range evaluation.

choices.label: Probe: DOMINANCE_BETWEEN (Check dominance in range [-100, 100])
choices.tooltip: Verifies dominance score boundary check.

scenes.bodyText:
[Domain: Anatomy & Biological Tags]
Select an anatomical condition probe:

choices.label: Probe: HAS_TAG (Check player anatomy has tag 'bipedal')
choices.tooltip: Verifies global anatomical body tag presence.

choices.label: Probe: HAS_MUTATION (Check active mutation 'test_mutation')
choices.tooltip: Verifies active mutation registry.

choices.label: Probe: IS_PREGNANT (Check gestation status)
choices.tooltip: Verifies biological gestation pregnancy flag.

choices.label: Probe: GENDER_IS (Check player gender archetype is MALE)
choices.tooltip: Verifies gender archetype matches MALE.

choices.label: Probe: RACE_IS / DOMINANT_RACE (Check player dominant race is Human)
choices.tooltip: Verifies dominant race calculation.

choices.label: Probe: TARGET_HAS_TAG (Check active target NPC has tag 'can_be_interrogated')
choices.tooltip: Verifies activeTargetNPC anatomical tag.

scenes.bodyText:
[Domain: Perks & Trait Flags]
Select a perk condition probe:

choices.label: Probe: HAS_PERK (Check player unlocked perk 'iron_constitution')
choices.tooltip: Verifies presence of iron_constitution perk.

choices.label: Probe: HAS_PERK_FLAG (Check player has perk flag 'unarmed_expert')
choices.tooltip: Verifies perk flag capability registration.

scenes.bodyText:
[Domain: Compound Boolean Logic Operators]
Select a boolean tree operator probe:

choices.label: Probe: LEAF Operator (Direct atomic condition evaluation)
choices.tooltip: Verifies leaf condition node evaluation.

choices.label: Probe: AND Operator (Physique >= 1.0 AND Hour 0-24)
choices.tooltip: Verifies AND operator: passes only if all child nodes evaluate true.

choices.label: Probe: OR Operator (Phase DAY OR Phase NIGHT)
choices.tooltip: Verifies OR operator: passes if any child node evaluates true.

choices.label: Probe: NOT Operator (NOT Physique >= 9999.0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies NOT operator: inverts the evaluation of its child node.

scenes.bodyText:
>>> VERIFICATION PASSED <<<

The queried condition evaluated to TRUE under current game state.
The arcane coordinate translocator hums with energy. Stepping onto the central pad will transport you back to the Test Hub central plaza.

choices.label: Activate Teleporter (Warp to Test Hub 1,1)
choices.tooltip: Engage the coordinate teleportation sequence.

scenes.bodyText:
=== GENERAL STATUS EFFECTS & LIFE CYCLE LAB ===

Status effects reflect current states, future biological/magical progressions, and permanent character conditions.

Active Status Effects on you are rendered as badges in your character card HUD with tooltips, durations, and stat influences.

Choose an action to verify:

choices.label: Apply Permanent Blessing (+25% Max Health, +10 Base Health)
choices.tooltip: Grants permanent status effect 'fx_blessing_vitality'. Remains indefinitely until cleansed.

results.extraString: Sacred divine aura fortifies the life force. Increases maximum health by 25% and provides +10 flat vitality.

choices.label: Apply Timed Rested State (8 Hours / 480 mins, +15% Mana)
choices.tooltip: Grants time-decaying status effect 'fx_well_rested'. Decays over 480 game minutes.

results.extraString: Deep slumber by the hearth has rejuvenated your mind. Increases maximum mana by 15%.

choices.label: Apply Permanent Heat & Erotic Sensitivity (+30% Lust Gain)
choices.tooltip: Grants status effect 'fx_heat_rut' representing heightened biological arousal state.

results.extraString: Pheromones surge as an instinctual mating rut takes hold. Increases lust and arousal susceptibility by 30%.

choices.label: Apply Toxic Debuff to NPC Target (2 Hours / 120 mins, -20 Stamina)
choices.tooltip: Grants debuff status effect 'fx_toxic_venom' to the active NPC target.

results.extraString: Virulent paralytic venom circulates through the bloodstream, draining 20 stamina.

choices.label: Test Condition: Check if Blessing of Vitality is Active
choices.tooltip: Unlocked only when 'fx_blessing_vitality' is currently active.

choices.label: Cleanse All Status Effects
choices.tooltip: Removes all status effects from player and restores baseline state.

choices.label: Return to Master Testing Console
choices.tooltip: Back to the master console.

scenes.bodyText:
[SUCCESS] HAS_STATUS_EFFECT condition check evaluated to TRUE!

The engine successfully verified that 'Blessing of Vitality' (fx_blessing_vitality) is currently active on your character entity.

choices.label: Back to Status Effects Lab
choices.tooltip: Return to the status effects testing panel.
